executive_summary.purpose: Test whether explicit 24-horizon sequence modeling improves over row-independent HGB
executive_summary.motivation: Measured autocorrelation (0.67-0.93) in horizon-varying NWP features
executive_summary.scale_justification: Small for 173 EVEN origins; prevents aggressive overfitting
executive_summary.causality_status: VERIFIED - bidirectional GRU causally permissible (complete forecast trajectory at t0)

feature_inventory.static_features_source: Prior day observations (Day D-1), available at t0
feature_inventory.static_features_verification: All 14 confirmed to have exactly 1 unique value per origin across H1-H24

architecture.name: Bidirectional GRU with Dense Input/Output Layers

parameter_count.correction_note: Corrected from ~6850 estimate; GRU input is 32 (from Dense1), not 39 (raw input)

causality_verification.question: Is bidirectional GRU processing causally permissible?

reasoning.forecast_availability: At t0 (Day D, 00:00 UTC), MEPS produces complete 24+ hour deterministic forecast containing covariates for H1...H24
reasoning.backward_gru_concern: Backward GRU processes H24→H23→...→H1 when predicting H1. Uses H24 covariates.
reasoning.backward_gru_justification: H24 covariates are forecast values (model's prediction of t0+24h conditions), not observations
reasoning.no_actual_observations: actual_SW_IN is never used as input; only forecast covariates available at t0
reasoning.no_future_errors: No forecast errors, residuals, or differences computed from future times
reasoning.no_odd_data: Only EVEN split used; ODD never accessed
reasoning.nwp_standard_practice: Using complete forecast trajectory to make predictions is standard in NWP-driven forecasting

explicit_non_leakage_checklist.no_future_observations: PASS - only forecast covariates from t0
explicit_non_leakage_checklist.no_future_residuals: PASS - no error computations from future times
explicit_non_leakage_checklist.backward_GRU_uses_forecast_only: PASS - H24 covariates are forecasts issued at t0
explicit_non_leakage_checklist.static_features_not_future: PASS - ctx_* from prior day, available at t0
explicit_non_leakage_checklist.no_information_after_t0: PASS - all 39 features known at t0

input_shape.static_features_broadcast: 14 static features identical across all 24 rows per origin
input_shape.static_features_verification: Confirmed: ctx_std_3h, ctx_std_6h, etc. have 1 unique value per origin
input_shape.static_not_future: NOT future information - summary statistics of prior day (Day D-1), available at t0

per_fold_structure.leakage_guarantee: Internal validation is subset of training pool, NOT from test fold

preprocessing.refit: NO - never refit on validation or test data

optimization.loss_computation: mean absolute error over 24 horizons per origin

G6.name: Numerical reproducibility
G6.control_status: APPROXIMATE (default HGB hyperparameters, not exact original Stage 8.1 code)

autocorrelation_alignment.justification: GRU explicitly models this trajectory structure HGB ignores

why_candidate_a_justified.not_phase9_rescue: Phase 9 added single features to HGB; Candidate A changes processing architecture (row-wise → sequence)
why_candidate_a_justified.appropriately_sized: 6049 params for 173 origins is conservative; allows trajectory learning without aggressive overfitting
why_candidate_a_justified.causally_sound: Complete MEPS forecast at t0; no future actuals, no future errors, no ODD data
why_candidate_a_justified.honest_uncertainty: H9-H12 error may be physical (input magnitude) not architectural; Candidate A not claimed to be silver bullet

explicit_non_claims: Not claimed that Candidate A will pass all gates

Not claimed that H9-H12 error is architecturally caused
Not claimed that 28.0688% nMAE is a theoretical lower bound
Not claimed that this will be the final champion
